meta.name: vercel-composition-patterns
meta.description: React composition patterns that scale. Use when refactoring components with boolean prop proliferation, building flexible component libraries, or designing reusable APIs. Triggers on tasks involving compound components, render props, context providers, or component architecture. Includes React 19 API changes.

copy.tagline: 用组合模式重构组件，消除布尔属性泛滥
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在重构组件或设计可复用的组件库
copy.tagline_en: Refactor components with composition patterns to eliminate boolean prop proliferation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are refactoring components or designing reusable component libraries

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会按照 React 组合模式重构组件，避免使用大量布尔属性，改用复合组件、状态提升等设计，并支持 React 19 新 API。
howto.when: 当你要求重构包含多个布尔属性的组件、构建可复用的组件库或设计组件 API 时触发。

say.text: 帮我重构这个表单组件，去掉那些布尔属性。
say.note: Claude 会应用复合组件模式来简化代码。

say.text: 用 React 19 的新 API 重写这个组件。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will refactor React components using composition patterns, avoiding boolean prop proliferation by applying compound components, state lifting, and React 19 APIs.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to refactor components with many boolean props, build reusable component libraries, or design component APIs.

say_en.text: Refactor this form component to remove boolean props.
say_en.note: Claude will apply compound component pattern.

say_en.text: Rewrite this component using React 19 APIs.
say_en.note: Claude will use use() instead of useContext.
